notes: Minutes and agendas of the Board of Trustees of the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco (the city board, 1973-82 and 2000-06) and of the Corporation of The Fine Arts Museums (the private board that raised money and built, 1987-2001), on the Internet Archive. Read for the two museum buildings: the 1976-77 de Young renovation, Edward Larrabee Barnes's 1990 master plans, the Legion of Honor's 1992-95 renovation, and the new de Young from Herzog & de Meuron's selection in 1999 to its opening in 2005. Staff and trustees are not named.

coverage.remaining: Two 2002 items (minutesagendas2002fine, _0) have no text layer. The topping-off of October 18, 2003 is only announced, not reported, so it is not placed. Exhibitions, acquisitions and budgets carry no building facts.
